hospitality.title: Room problem? Report it at once.
hospitality.lead: From a problem in the room to a clear task for the right team. A guest or staff member scans a QR code, reports the issue and can add a photo. The team completes it.

video.title: See how WinProx works
video.lead: A guest reports a broken lamp, an air-conditioning fault or another issue. It becomes a task for the right team. No app, no phone chain, no paper notes.

problem.title: A small problem can quickly become a bad review
problem.lead: A guest notices the air conditioning is down, the television will not work or the shower is faulty. A call to reception, a message to maintenance, someone has to remember — and the guest waits. With WinProx this is one workflow.
questions: Are maintenance or housekeeping on it?

items.body: The guest or staff member scans the QR code in the room or on site.

items.title: Report
items.body: The issue is reported on the smartphone. A photo can be added at once.

items.title: Task
items.body: The issue becomes a task for the team you link.

items.title: Done

roles.title: One system for the whole hotel

items.title: For guests
items.body: Report a problem without calling. Scan the QR code, describe the issue and optionally add a photo. No app and no account.

items.title: For reception
items.body: Fewer phone calls and a clearer picture. Issues become a task for the team you link — no paper-note chain.

items.title: For maintenance
items.body: Clear tasks with the right location. See what to do, where it is and what the guest or colleague reported.

items.title: For housekeeping
items.body: Small problems are easy to pass on: a broken lamp or damage becomes a task at once.

why.title: Why WinProx
items: WinProx is one facility app, not a hotel PMS or a separate hospitality product.
No app for guests or staff: a smartphone and QR code are enough.
Issues become a task for the team you link.
Less phone chain between reception, housekeeping and maintenance.
A photo with the issue gives the team context at once.
Management follows every issue until it is closed, tied to the location.

start.title: Start small. Grow when it works.
start.lead: You do not have to convert the whole hotel at once. Start with 10 rooms, one floor or one team, for example.
start.trial: One month free, up to 50 units. No install.

close.title: Ready to try it?
close.lead: Turn every hotel room or hospitality site into a simple reporting point. Managers create an account; guests and staff scan and report.
